title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Economics 9708 syllabus
version: Minimal (chapter list only, one placeholder section/outcome per chapter)

source.method: Chapter and section titles taken from the syllabus's own numbered subject-content list (1.1-11.6); outcomes within each section are not individually extracted, one placeholder outcome per chapter instead, so question topics have a valid ref to point at. Not a full extraction of every numbered syllabus sub-point.

topics.title: Basic economic ideas and resource allocation

sections.title: Basic economic ideas and resource allocation

outcomes.text: Scarcity, choice and opportunity cost; economic methodology; factors of production; resource allocation in different economic systems; production possibility curves; classification of goods and services.

topics.title: The price system and the microeconomy

sections.title: The price system and the microeconomy

outcomes.text: Demand and supply curves; price, income and cross elasticity of demand; price elasticity of supply; the interaction of demand and supply; consumer and producer surplus.
Reasons for government intervention in markets; methods and effects of government intervention in markets; addressing income and wealth inequality.
National income statistics; the circular flow of income; aggregate demand and aggregate supply; economic growth; employment and unemployment; price stability.
Government macroeconomic policy objectives; fiscal policy; monetary policy; supply-side policy.

Globalisation; trade; trading blocs and the World Trade Organization; the current account of the balance of payments; exchange rates; policies to correct imbalances in the current account of the balance of payments.

topics.title: The price system and the microeconomy

sections.title: The price system and the microeconomy

outcomes.text: Price elasticity of demand and pricing decisions; marginal utility theory; indifference curve analysis; the market mechanism, resource allocation and the roles of the price mechanism; types of cost, revenue and profit; different market structures; growth and survival of firms; differing objectives and policies of firms.

Government policies to achieve efficient resource allocation and correct market failure; equality, equity and efficiency; labour market forces and government intervention; government failure in microeconomic intervention.
The circular flow of income (multiplier, AD components); money and banking; macroeconomic policy instruments.

Government macroeconomic policy objectives; links between macroeconomic problems and their interrelatedness; conflicts between macroeconomic policy objectives; policies to meet macroeconomic objectives; government failure in macroeconomic intervention.

The terms of trade; economic integration; economic growth and economic development; characteristics of countries at different levels of development; international trade and capital flows; the role of financial markets.
